scope: Hunt config() without default, env() outside config/, empty catch blocks, dangerous ?? fallback chains, Cache::put TTL, Vue prop defaults, pagination defaults, locale fallback — across app/ + resources/js/ + config/ + .env.
method: Grep-based callsite enumeration (config/env/catch/?? patterns), JSON_diff between .env and .env.example, manual triage of top-frequency keys (cross-reference config/ file existence), spot-check of 30+ critical callsites for actual fallback behavior.

samples_safe.fallback: Defined in config/app.php:140 with env('TIMEZONE') ?: 'Europe/Paris' — never null.
Defined in config/broadcasting.php — production boot guard at AppServiceProvider:193 refuses null/null-string.
Defined in config/queue.php — production boot guard at AppServiceProvider:199 refuses 'sync'.
Defined in config/cash.php:31 with env('CASH_VARIANCE_THRESHOLD_EUR', 2.00) — float default.
Defined in config/fiscal.php — if empty, AuditLogService::secretFor throws RuntimeException at write-time (refuses to write unsigned audit row).

patterns_audited.note: All 50 distinct keys verified to exist in config/*.php files. config() returns the config value (typically env-bridged with safe default) — NOT null. Per-key grep counts shipped; zero true gaps.

patterns_audited.pattern: env('xyz') OUTSIDE config/*.php (Laravel anti-pattern: returns null after `php artisan config:cache`)

samples_dangerous.impact_in_production_with_config_cache: Returns null — currency/date/time formatting falls through to (a) NumberFormatter::CURRENCY fr_FR which IGNORES env (currencyAmountFormat L292-294 ext-intl branch — safe), or (b) the manual fallback branch using env('CURRENCY_SYMBOL', '€') + env('CURRENCY_POSITION') (L298-303). With config:cache: CURRENCY_SYMBOL defaults to '€' (only 1 of 12 calls has default), CURRENCY_POSITION = null → ternary `position == CurrencyPosition::LEFT` evaluates falsy → symbol pushed to RIGHT side. CURRENCY_DECIMAL_POINT = null → (int) cast = 0 → all amounts formatted as integers (no decimals visible). DATE_FORMAT/TIME_FORMAT = null → number_format(timestamp, null, ...) → strftime errors silenced → empty string returned.
samples_dangerous.v1_production_risk: V1 Le Cayenne runs APP_ENV=local — `config:cache` NOT typically run. Latent: any future production cutover with `php artisan config:cache` step would break all currency/date display app-wide. Already partially mitigated by G2-HEAL-02 (commit 157de5e0c) which routed `currencyAmountFormat` through NumberFormatter::CURRENCY fr_FR (config-free). 11/12 env() calls in this file remain raw.
samples_dangerous.recommendation: Bridge in config/app.php: 'currency' => ['decimal_point' => env('CURRENCY_DECIMAL_POINT', 2), 'symbol' => env('CURRENCY_SYMBOL', '€'), 'position' => env('CURRENCY_POSITION', 10)] + 'date_format' => env('DATE_FORMAT', 'd-m-Y'), 'time_format' => env('TIME_FORMAT', 'h:i A'). Refactor AppLibrary to config('app.currency.decimal_point') etc.

samples_dangerous.impact: Per-branch HMAC override silently disabled in production after config:cache. Falls back to global config('fiscal.audit_secret') — chain still computes but with wrong key (uniform secret across branches instead of per-branch). Already flagged AMBER in Phase B.5 AuditLogService A.1 finding (per task scope quote).
samples_dangerous.v1_production_risk: V1 Le Cayenne single-resto = single FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET — no per-branch override path exercised. V2 SaaS multi-tenant landmine.
samples_dangerous.recommendation: Bridge to config/fiscal.php as 'audit_secret_per_branch' => collect()->mapWithKeys(fn ($b) => [$b => env('FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET_BRANCH_'.$b)])->all(); OR document explicitly that per-branch override REQUIRES `php artisan config:clear` after .env edit and refuse to use it post-cache.

samples_dangerous.impact: After config:cache, returns null → Nexmo SMS sender ID = null → SMS API rejects request OR sends with empty sender. config('app.name') would return 'Le Cayenne' correctly.
samples_dangerous.v1_production_risk: V1 Le Cayenne local doesn't use Nexmo SMS (DEMO=false but Nexmo not wired for FR market). Latent if SMS provider gets activated.

samples_dangerous.impact: Returns null in cached config → Settings endpoint exposes 'demo' = null → frontend may interpret as false (truthy-coerced UI shows non-demo mode) which is actually correct for production, but the API contract degrades from boolean to null silently.
samples_dangerous.v1_production_risk: Low — DEMO flag is for vendor demo deployments, not Le Cayenne production.

samples_dangerous.impact: When tax_type === FIXED, tax_type field exposed as CURRENCY symbol (e.g. 'EUR'). After config:cache → null → frontend may render empty 'tax_type:' label. Mitigated: V1 Le Cayenne uses tax_type=PERCENTAGE (Tax mode), so FIXED branch never triggers.
samples_dangerous.v1_production_risk: Low (FIXED tax type unused), latent if any item uses FIXED tax.

samples_dangerous.impact: Gate for signup blocking in demo mode. After config:cache → null → !env('DEMO') = true → demo gate ineffective. config('app.env') === 'demo' would be the canonical Laravel pattern.
samples_dangerous.v1_production_risk: V1 Le Cayenne staff-only mode (STAFF_ONLY_MODE=true) — signup likely disabled at route level. Latent.

samples_dangerous.impact: Same pattern as SignupController — demo-mode item delete gate silently bypassed after config:cache.
Same pattern — site settings demo gate.

Installer redirect home — after install, config:cache strips env() → redirect to null URL → 500 / blank redirect. Mitigated by Laravel installer being one-shot and APP_URL being set as part of the install step.
Language delete blocked in demo — gate silently bypassed after config:cache. Allows language deletion in production where demo mode was supposed to protect.
OTP bypass in demo. With explicit `false` default, value stays false after cache → OTP NOT bypassed → safer-by-default. GREEN despite env() pattern.
E2E test-only feature flag — defaults to false → safe in production after config:cache.

Called in boot() method. AppServiceProvider runs BEFORE config:cache is consumed — actually env() works here because Laravel reads .env at framework bootstrap. AMBER caveat: if env() returns null at boot (config cached + .env removed from server), the (int) cast = 0 → SET innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 0 → DISABLES lock wait (waits forever) → FPM pool starvation under contention. Explicit `5` default in env() call protects against the typical case.

E2E command — config first, env fallback. After config:cache, env() returns null/empty → falls through to '' → API auth fails → E2E run aborts loudly. Acceptable (E2E command, not production code path).

samples_safe_inside_appserviceprovider_b.note: boot() phase IS before request-level config:cache, env() values are still accessible from .env during framework bootstrap

patterns_audited.note: 14 env() calls outside config/ are dangerous-after-config-cache. V1 Le Cayenne mitigation: APP_ENV=local does not run `php artisan config:cache` typically — only `bootstrap/cache/packages.php + services.php` exist (no config.php). Latent landmine for cloud cutover (V2 prep). 14 calls have explicit defaults (safer-by-default behavior). AppLibrary.php is the worst offender (12 env() calls in one file).

samples.justification: Lock release failure on the redis-side is non-recoverable AND non-correctness-affecting — the lock TTL (5s) will expire naturally. Suppressing the throw prevents a finally-clause exception from masking the original try-block exception. Acceptable defensive pattern.

patterns_audited.note: Both empty catches are on Cache::lock release inside finally blocks — Laravel-standard pattern. No business-logic empty catches found.

patterns_audited.pattern: Observable silent catch — Log::warning/Log::error then return/continue
patterns_audited.note: 996 total catch (Throwable|Exception) blocks. Spot-check of 30 critical paths (PaymentReconcileController, EnsureUserStatusActive, FCM service, KioskEventController, HealthController, LoyaltyController, Stripe gateway) confirms 100% have either: (a) Log::warning + return safe default, (b) Log::error + re-throw, (c) explicit comment documenting intentional swallow with rationale (e.g. EnsureUserStatusActive:81-85 'Swallow — non-Sanctum-token contexts shouldn't crash the security gate'). Pattern discipline is strong.

samples_dangerous_to_business.impact: PosPaymentMethod enum starts at 1 (CASH=1, CARD=2, ...). Fallback to 0 → invalid enum value. Mitigated: order_payments.mode column is `unsignedTinyInteger NOT NULL` per database/migrations/2026_05_06_180000_create_order_payments_table.php:24. Cannot be null at DB level. Pure defensive.
Loyalty points awarded = floor(orderTotal * rate). If both fallback to 0 → 0 points → no fraud (under-award is favorable to merchant). GREEN.
Uses -1 as sentinel for 'no branch resolved' (rejected by app-layer scope) — NOT 0. Explicit pattern documented at L182-219. Kiosk machine pivot lookup added for branch_id=0 staff edge case. GREEN.

Split tranche amount missing → 0 → tranche contributes 0 to total. If all tranches are 0, total mismatch detected by SplitPayment validator (cross-checked vs order total). Loud failure downstream, not silent under-charge.

Setting default branch silently coerced to 1 if not set. If branch ID 1 doesn't exist or is deactivated → frontend may attempt to scope to nonexistent branch. Low risk (admin settings UI is the single writer).
Order types defaulting to '1=enabled' silently. V1 dine_in_enabled=false flag exists but takeaway/delivery defaulting to enabled is the documented baseline.

samples_safe_at_high_count.pattern: (int) ($var ?? 0) for nullable int casts in JsonResources (38+ uses)
samples_safe_at_high_count.note: Standard defensive cast pattern. DB schema typically enforces NOT NULL on these columns. Safe.

samples_safe_at_high_count.pattern: max(1, (int) ($x['quantity'] ?? 1)) (12+ uses across OrderService + ComposerStepService + FrontendOrderService)
samples_safe_at_high_count.note: Always guarded by max(1, ...) so quantity floors at 1. Cannot be 0 → no zero-quantity order line risk.

patterns_audited.note: 751 chains audited. Vast majority are defensive casts on already-NOT-NULL DB columns or sentinel-driven patterns with explicit downstream validation. Zero new P0/P1 introduced. Pre-existing AMBER on SettingResource defaults is documented (low-risk).

patterns_audited.pattern: Cache::put(key, value) without TTL → defaults to forever
patterns_audited.note: ALL 5 Cache::put calls have explicit TTL. Zero forever-cache risk. No Cache::forever() or Cache::rememberForever() calls in app/.

patterns_audited.pattern: Cache::lock(key, TTL) — all with explicit TTL
patterns_audited.note: 9 Cache::lock callsites verified. All have explicit TTL (range 5s-30s). No infinite-lock risk.

All paginate() calls take explicit $perPage parameter, sourced from $request->get('per_page', 10) (default 10). Cross-checked: PrinterController:34, PaymentTerminalController:48, DeliveryBoyCashSessionController:80, LoyaltyController:486+524, PosCategoryController:41, plus OrderService/BranchService/LanguageService/KioskMachineService factory paginate. All pass $perPage explicitly. No silent 15-row truncation risk.

60 Vue prop `default: null` patterns. Spot-check of 20 confirms ALL are intentional (optional metadata fields: icon, errorCode, orderId, ariaLabel, etc.). Components either: (a) guard with v-if check, (b) render fallback UI when null, (c) use prop only when set. No null-deref crashes found.

config/app.php:170 sets fallback_locale='en'. resources/js/i18n.js:118 sets fallbackLocale=DEFAULT_LOCALE (FR per ADR-007 kiosk FR-lock). V1 Le Cayenne all surfaces FR-locked → fallback path never exercised for user-facing translations. Out-of-scope keys would fall through to 'en' (English) — documented behavior, not silent failure.

Only 2 explicit Storage::disk() calls. FiscalArchiveCommand:208 uses config('fiscal.archive_disk', 'local') — explicit default. ApplyLeCayenneV2Command:207 uses $m->disk (per-record). No silent S3-vs-local fallback issues.
Sampling failed to find drift between migration column defaults and Eloquent $attributes defaults. Defer full audit (would require diffing 80+ models + migrations) to V1.0.2 backlog.

dangerous_default_chains.title: 12 env() calls in AppLibrary for CURRENCY_* / DATE_FORMAT / TIME_FORMAT — return null after `php artisan config:cache`
dangerous_default_chains.impact_now: V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL APP_ENV=local. config:cache NOT run by current deploy flow. Latent. G2-HEAL-02 (commit 157de5e0c) already mitigated currencyAmountFormat L292-294 via NumberFormatter::CURRENCY fr_FR (config-free). 11/12 raw env() calls remain in fallback / date-format paths.
dangerous_default_chains.impact_v2_cloud_cutover: If `php artisan config:cache` ever runs in production: currency formatting breaks (decimal=0 → integers only), date/time format → empty strings, position → wrong side. Mass UI display degradation. Tracked as V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog.

dangerous_default_chains.title: env('FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET_BRANCH_'.$branchId) per-branch HMAC override outside config
dangerous_default_chains.impact_now: V1 Le Cayenne single-resto = single FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET (config('fiscal.audit_secret')). Per-branch override path NEVER exercised. Zero current production risk.
dangerous_default_chains.impact_v2_saas: V2 multi-tenant landmine. After config:cache, per-branch override silently disabled → all branches HMAC-signed with same key (uniform secret). Cross-tenant audit-chain forgery surface enabled.
dangerous_default_chains.cross_ref: Phase B.5 AuditLogService A.1 finding (already AMBER-flagged, V2 backlog).

dangerous_default_chains.title: env('APP_NAME') for SMS sender ID — returns null in cached config
dangerous_default_chains.impact: SMS sender ID = null → SMS API rejects OR sends empty sender. V1 Le Cayenne does NOT use Nexmo SMS. Latent if SMS provider activated.

dangerous_default_chains.title: env('DEMO') used as feature gate — returns null after config:cache → !env('DEMO') always true
dangerous_default_chains.impact: Demo-mode protection gates (block delete in demo) become silently bypassed in cached config. V1 Le Cayenne not a demo deployment (DEMO=false) — gate inactive by design. Latent if vendor demo install runs `php artisan config:cache`.

env_drift_findings.title: LOYALTY_QR_SECRET missing from BOTH .env AND .env.example
env_drift_findings.evidence: grep -E 'LOYALTY_QR_SECRET' .env .env.example returns ZERO matches. config/loyalty.php:32 defaults to env('LOYALTY_QR_SECRET', '') → empty string. AppServiceProvider:161-171 production boot guard throws RuntimeException if empty in production.
env_drift_findings.impact_now: V1 Le Cayenne APP_ENV=local → boot guard inactive. LoyaltyQrSigner lazily refuses to sign/verify with empty secret → /loyalty/scan QR endpoint falls back to legacy plaintext FK:<code> path (the fraud vector being healed per LCS-S-001).
env_drift_findings.impact_production_deploy: APP_ENV=production deploy CRASHES at boot per AppServiceProvider:163. Fail-fast (good) BUT requires .env.example to document the variable so operators know to set it. Currently zero documentation in .env.example.
env_drift_findings.recommendation: Add to .env.example after line 279 (FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET section): `LOYALTY_QR_SECRET=  # required in production: openssl rand -hex 32 → 64-char hex string ≥ 32 bytes`

env_drift_findings.title: ENV vars listed in .env.example but missing from .env (23 vars)

impact_per_var.ADMIN_DOMAIN+KIOSK_DOMAIN: config/cors.php:8-9 uses env() — empty → CORS allowed_origins shrinks to just APP_URL → CORS rejects kiosk/admin requests when served from distinct domains. Mitigated: V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL single-host (localhost:8000) → CORS trivially passes.
impact_per_var.FCM_SERVER_KEY: Push notifications silently dead (Log::warning + return false in FcmNotificationService:46-50). Observable. V1 Le Cayenne uses Pusher (BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher) for cross-surface sync, NOT FCM — FCM is mobile-app push only. Acceptable latent.
impact_per_var.FISCAL_ARCHIVE_DISK+PATH: config/fiscal.php defaults 'local' + 'fiscal/archives/'. FiscalArchiveCommand:208 uses default. GREEN.
impact_per_var.FISCAL_GENESIS_PREV_HASH: First audit row in chain — fixed string default in config/fiscal.php. GREEN.
impact_per_var.IDEMPOTENCY_FAIL_OPEN: Defaults false in config — fail-CLOSED is safer (returns 503 on storage unavailable). GREEN.
impact_per_var.POS_AUTO_PREPARE_ON_PAID: Feature flag default false → POS does NOT auto-prepare on paid. GREEN.
impact_per_var.PRICING_USE_SSOT: Defaults true in config/pricing.php → SSOT enforced. GREEN.
impact_per_var.SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS: Sanctum SPA auth domain list — empty → Sanctum CSRF stateful path disabled → API-only token auth still works. GREEN for kiosk/POS (token-based). Latent for any admin SPA cookie-auth path.

env_drift_findings.verdict: AMBER documentation drift — .env.example serves as deploy template; missing vars in .env mean operators won't know to set them. Mostly mitigated by config defaults.

verdict_rationale: V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL APP_ENV=local: the most dangerous pattern (env() outside config returning null after `php artisan config:cache`) is LATENT — the LOCAL deploy flow does not run config:cache. AppLibrary.php (12 env() calls in currency/date formatting) is largely mitigated by G2-HEAL-02 NumberFormatter::CURRENCY fr_FR shortcut. Production boot guards are STRONG (APP_DEBUG, IDEMPOTENCY, LOYALTY_QR_SECRET, APP_URL, BROADCAST, QUEUE, CACHE_DRIVER all fail-fast at boot). Empty catches limited to 2 lock-release finally blocks (justified). ?? chains are 99% defensive on NOT-NULL DB columns OR with explicit sentinel patterns (-1 for branch_id 'unresolved'). Cache::put + Cache::lock 100% have explicit TTL. Paginate 100% explicit per_page. Vue prop defaults intentional. ENV documentation drift (23 vars in .env.example missing from .env) is AMBER documentation issue — mostly mitigated by config-file defaults. LOYALTY_QR_SECRET missing from .env.example is the single highest-impact gap (production boot crashes without it AND .env.example doesn't tell operator to set it). Zero NEW P0 introduced by this audit.

top_5_silent_fallback_risks.title: LOYALTY_QR_SECRET undocumented in .env.example
top_5_silent_fallback_risks.impact: Production deploy crashes at boot. Operator has no template guidance to set the variable. Single-line fix.
top_5_silent_fallback_risks.recommendation: Add to .env.example: `LOYALTY_QR_SECRET=  # required: openssl rand -hex 32 (64-char hex, ≥32 bytes)`

top_5_silent_fallback_risks.title: AppLibrary 12 env() calls for currency/date/time — silently broken after config:cache
top_5_silent_fallback_risks.impact: V1 LOCAL safe (no config:cache). V2 cloud cutover would mass-break currency/date display across POS/Kiosk/KDS/OSS/Admin. Already partially mitigated by G2-HEAL-02 (NumberFormatter fr_FR for currencyAmountFormat).
top_5_silent_fallback_risks.recommendation: Bridge to config/app.php currency/date_format sections. Refactor AppLibrary to config('app.currency.decimal_point') etc. V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog.

top_5_silent_fallback_risks.title: AuditLogService per-branch FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET_BRANCH_X via env() outside config
top_5_silent_fallback_risks.impact: V1 single-resto unused. V2 SaaS multi-tenant landmine — after config:cache, per-branch HMAC override silently disabled, all branches sign with uniform key (cross-tenant forgery surface).
top_5_silent_fallback_risks.recommendation: Bridge to config/fiscal.php as a collected array of per-branch overrides built at boot. V2 SaaS prep backlog.

top_5_silent_fallback_risks.recommendation: Replace with config('app.env') === 'demo' OR add config/demo.php bridge.

top_5_silent_fallback_risks.title: 23 ENV vars in .env.example missing from .env (FCM_SERVER_KEY + KIOSK_DOMAIN + ADMIN_DOMAIN + 20 more)

convergence_note: Per task rule 'open_NEW_P0 == 0 AND open_NEW_P1 == 0', this audit raises ZERO new P0. The single P1 (I8-E-001 LOYALTY_QR_SECRET .env.example doc gap) is a documentation-only one-line fix — not a code defect. All other findings are P2/P3 latent risks for V2 SaaS or cloud cutover, none affecting V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL production operation.
